aa daasudu thana yajamaanudagu abraahaamu thoda krinda thana cheyyi petti yee sangathi vishayamai pramaanamu chesenu.

athadu thana yajamaanuni ontelalo padhi ontelanu thana yajamaa nuni aasthilo shreshtamaina naanaa vidhamulagu vasthuvulanu theesikoni poyenu. Athadu lechi araamnaharaayimu lonunna naahoru pattanamu cheri
saayankaalamandu streelu neellu chedukonavachu velaku aa oori bayatanunna neellabaaviyoddha thana ontelanu moka rimpachesi yitlanenu
naa yajamaanudagu abraahaamu dhevudavaina yehovaa, nenuvachina kaaryamunu tvaralo saphalamuchesi naa yajamaanudagu abraahaamu meeda anugrahamu choopumu.
chittha ginchumu, nenu ee neella ootayoddha niluchu chunnaanu; ee oorivaari pillalu neellu chedukonutaku vachuchunnaaru.

kaabatti nenu traagunatlu neevu dayachesi nee kadavanu vanchumani nenu cheppagaaneevu traagumu nee ontelakunu neellu pettedhanani ye chinnadhi cheppuno aameye nee sevakudaina issaakukoraku neevu niyaminchinadai yundunu gaaka, anduvalana neevu naa yajamaanunimeeda anugrahamu choopithivani telisikondu nanenu.
athadu maatalaaduta chaalimpakamundhe abraahaamu sahodarudaina naahoru bhaaryayagu milkaa kumaarudaina bethooyeluku puttina ribkaa kadava bhujamu meeda pettukonivacchenu.
aa chinnadhi mikkili chakkanidi; aame kanyaka, e purushudunu aamenu koodaledu; aame aa baaviloniki digipoyi kadavanu neellathoo nimpukoniyekki raagaa
aa sevakudu aamenu edurkonutaku parugetthi nee kadavalo neellu konchemu dayachesi nannu traaga nimmani adigenu.
andukaame ayyaa traagu mani cheppi tvaragaa thana kadavanu chethimeediki dinchukoni athaniki daahamicchenu.
mariyu aame athaniki daaha michina tharuvaathanee ontelu traagumattuku vaatikini neellu chedipoyudunani cheppi
tvaragaa gaadilo thana kadava kummarinchi thirigi chedutaku aa baaviki parugetthu koni poyi athani ontelannitiki neellu chediposenu.
aa manushyudu aamenu theri chuchi thana prayaanamunu yehovaa saphalamucheseno ledo telisikonava lenani oora kundenu.
ontelu traagutayaina tharuvaatha aa manushyudu arathulamu etthugala bangaarapu mukku kammini, aame chethulaku padhi thulamula etthu gala rendu bangaaru kadiyamulanu theesi
neevu evari kumaarthevu? Dayachesi naathoo cheppumu; nee thandri yinta memu ee raatri basacheyutaku sthalamunnadaa ani adigenu.
andukaame nenu naahoruku milkaakanina kumaarudagu bethooyelu kumaarthenanenu.
mariyu aame maa yoddha chaalaa gaddiyu methayu raatri basacheyutaku sthalamunu unna vanagaa
aa manushyudu thana thala vanchi yehovaaku mrokki

abraahaamanu naa yaajamaanuni dhevudaina yehovaa sthuthimpabadunugaaka; aayana naa yajamaanuniki thana krupanu thana satyamunu chooputa maanaledu; nenu trovalo nundagaane yehovaa naa yajamaanuni bhandhuvula intiki nannu nadipinchenu.
anthata aa chinnadhi parugetthikonipoyi yee maatalu thana thalli yinti vaariki telipenu.
ribkaaku laabaananu noka sahodaru dundenu. Appudu laabaanu aa baavidaggara velu patanunna aa manushyuni yoddhaku parugetthikoni poyenu.

athadu aa mukku kammini thana sahodari chethulanunna aa kadiyamulanu chuchi'aa manushyudu eelaagu naathoo maatalaadenani thana sahodariyaina ribkaa cheppina maatalu vini aa manushyuni yoddhaku vacchenu.Athadu aa baaviyoddha ontela daggara nilichi yundagaa
laabaanu yehovaa valana aasheervadhimpabadina vaadaa, lopaliki rammu; neevu bayata niluvanela? Illunu ontelaku sthalamunu nenu siddhamu cheyinchithinanenu.
aa manushyudu intiki vachi nappudu laabaanu ontela ganthalu vippi ontelaku gaddiyu methayu kaallu kadugu konutaku athanikini athanithoo kooda nunnavaarikini neellu ichi
athaniki bhojanamu pettinchenu gaani athadu nenu vachina pani cheppaka munupu bhojanamu cheyananagaa laabaanu cheppumanenu.
anthata athaditlanenu. Nenu abraahaamu daasudanu,
yehovaa naa yajamaanuni bahugaa aasheervadhinchenu ganuka athadu goppavaadaayenu; athaniki gorrelanu godlanu vendi bangaaramulanu daasa daasee janamunu ontelanu gaadidalanu dayachesenu.
naa yajamaanuni bhaaryayaina shaaraa vruddhaapyamulo naa yajamaanuniki kumaaruni kanenu; naa yajamaanudu thanaku kaliginadhi yaavatthunu athanikichi yunnaadu;
mariyu naa yajamaanudu naathoo nenu evari dheshamandu nivasinchuchunnaano aa kanaaneeyula pillalalo oka pillanu naa kumaaruniki pendlicheyavaddu.
ayithe naa thandri yintikini naa vanshasthula yoddhakunu velli naa kumaaruniki pendli cheyutaku oka pillanu theesikoni raavalenani naachetha pramaanamu cheyinchenu.
appudu nenu naa yajamaanunithoo aa stree naaventa raadhemo ani cheppinanduku

athadu evani sannidhilo nenu jeevinchuchunnaano aa yehovaa neethoo kooda thana doothanu pampi nee prayaanamu saphalamu cheyunu ganuka neevu naa vanshasthulalo naa thandri yintanundi naa kumaaruniki bhaaryanu teesikoni vachedhavu
neevu naa vanshasthulayoddhaku vellithivaa yee pramaanamu vishayamulo ika neeku baadhyatha undadu, vaaru aamenu iyyani yedala kooda ee pramaanamu vishayamulo neeku baadhyatha undadani cheppenu.
nenu nedu aa baavi yoddhaku vachi abraahaamanu naa yajamaanuni dhevudavaina yehovaa, naa prayaanamunu neevu saphalamu chesina yedala
nenu ee neella baaviyoddha nilichiyundagaa neellu chedukonutaku vachina chinna daanithoo nenuneevu dayachesi nee kadavalo neellu konchemu nannu traaganimmani cheppunappudu
neevu traagumu nee ontelakunu chedi poyudunani yevate cheppuno aameye naa yajamaanuni kumaaruniki yehovaa niyaminchina pillayai yundunu gaakani manavi chesikontini.

nenu naa hrudayamulo atlu anukonuta chaalimpaka mundhe ribkaa bhujamumeeda thana kadavanu pettukoni vachi aa baavi loniki digipoyi neellu chedukoni vacchenu; appudu naaku daahamimmani nenaamenu adugagaa
aame tvaragaa thana kadavanu dinchi traagumu, nee ontelakunu neellu pettedhanani cheppenu ganuka nenu traagithini; aame ontelakunu neellu pettenu.
appudu nenu-neevu evari kumaarthevani yadiginanduku aame-milkaa naahorunaku kanina kumaarudagu bethooyelu kumaarthenani cheppinappudu, ne naame mukkuku kammiyunu aame chethula kadiyamulanu petti

naa thalavanchi yehovaaku mrokki, abraahaamanu naa yajamaanuni dhevudaina yehovaanu sthootramu chesithini; yelayanagaa aayana naa yajamaanuni yokka sahodaruni kumaarthenu athani kumaaruniki theesikonunatlu sariyaina maargamandu nannu nadipinchenu.
kaabatti naa yajamaanuniyedala meeru dayanu nammakamunu kanuparachina yedala adhiyainanu naaku teliyacheppudi, leniyedala adhiyainanu teliya cheppudi; appudu nenetu povaleno atu poyedhananagaa
laabaanunu bethooyelunu idi yehovaavalana kaligina kaaryamu; memaithe avunani gaani kaadanigaani cheppa jaalamu;
idigo ribkaa nee yeduta nunnadhi, aamenu theesikoni pommu; yehovaa selavichina prakaaramu eeme nee yajamaanuni kumaaruniki bhaarya agunu gaakani uttharamichiri.
abraahaamu sevakudu vaari maatalu vini yehovaaku saashtaanga namaskaaramu chesenu.
tharuvaatha aa sevakudu vendi nagalanu bangaaru nagalanu, vastramulanu theesi ribkaaku icchenu; mariyu athadu aame sahodaruniki thallikini viluvagala vasthuvulu icchenu.
athadunu athanithoo koodanunna manushyulunu annapaanamulu puchukoni akkada aa raatriyanthayu nundiri. Udayamuna vaaru lechinappudu athadu naa yajamaanuni yoddhaku nannu pampinchudani cheppagaa
aame sahodarudunu aame thalliyu ee chinnadaani padhi dinamulainanu maayoddha unda nimmu, aa tharuvaatha aame vellavachu naniri.
appudathadu yehovaa naa prayaanamunu saphalamu chesenu ganuka naaku thadavu kaaneeyaka nannu pampinchudi, naa yajamaanuni yoddhaku velledhanani cheppinappudu
vaaru aa chinna daanini pilichi, aame yemanuno telisikondamani cheppukoni
ribkaanu pilichi ee manushyunithoo kooda velledavaa ani aame nadiginappudu velledhananenu.
kaabatti vaaru thama sahodariyaina ribkaanu aame daadhini abraahaamu sevakuni athanithoo vachina manushyulanu saaganampinappudu
vaaru ribkaathoo maa sahodaree, neevu vela velaku thalli vaguduvu gaaka, nee santhathivaaru thama pagavaari gavinini svaadheenaparachukonduru gaaka ani aamenu deevimpagaa
ribkaayu aame pani kattelunu lechi ontela nekki aa manushyuni vembadi velliri. Atlu aa sevakudu ribkaanu thoodukoni poyenu.
issaaku beyer‌ lahaayiroyi maargamuna vachi dakshina dheshamandu kaapuramundenu.
saayankaalamuna issaaku polamulo dhyaanimpa bayaluvelli kannuletthi chuchinappudu ontelu vachuchundenu,
ribkaa kannu letthi issaakunu chuchi ontemeedanundi digi
manala nedurkonutaku polamulo naduchuchunna aa manushyudevarani daasuni nadugagaa athadu ithadu naa yajamaanudani cheppenu ganuka aame musuku vesikonenu.
appudaa daasudu thaanu chesina karyamulanniyu issakuthoo vivarinchi cheppenu.

issaaku thalliyaina shaaraa gudaaramu loniki aamenu theesikoni poyenu. Atlu athadu ribkaanu parigrahimpagaa aame athaniki bhaarya aayenu; athadu aamenu preminchenu. Appudu issaaku thana thalli vishayamai duḥkhanivaarana pondhenu.
abraahaamu marala oka streeni vivaahamu chesikonenu, aame peru kethooraa.
aame athaniki jimraanu, yokshaanu, medaanu, midyaanu, ishbaaku, shoovahu anuvaarini kanenu.
yokshaanu shebanu dedaanunu kanenu. Ashshooreeyulu lethoosheeyulu leyumeeyulu anuvaaru aa dedaanu santhathivaaru.
eyiphaa epheru hanoku abeedaa eldaayaa anuvaaru aa midyaanu santhathivaaru.
veerandaru kethooraa santhathivaaru. Abraahaamu thanaku kaliginadhi yaavatthu issaaku kicchenu.
abraahaamu thana upapatnula kumaarulaku bahumaanamu lichi, thaanu sajeevudai yundagaane thana kumaarudagu issaaku noddhanundi thoorpu thattugaa thoorpu dheshamunaku vaarini pampivesenu.
abraahaamu bradhikina samvatsaramulu noota debbadhiyaidu.
abraahaamu nindu vruddhaapyamunaku vachinavaadai manchi musalithanamuna praanamu vidichi mruthibondi thana pitharulayoddhaku cherchabadenu.
hittheeyudaina soharu kumaarudagu ephronu polamandali makpelaa guhalo athani kumaarulagu issaakunu ishmaayelunu athanini paathipettiri; adhi mamre yeduta nunnadhi.
abraahaamu hethu kumaarulayoddha konina polamulone abraahaamunu athani bhaaryayaina shaaraayunu paathi pettabadiri.
abraahaamu mruthibondina tharuvaatha dhevudu athani kumaarudagu issaakunu aasheervadhinchenu; appudu issaaku beyer‌ lahaayiroyi daggara kaapuramundenu.
aiguptheeyuraalunu shaaraa daasiyunaina haagaru abraahaamunaku kanina abraahaamu kumaarudagu ishmaayelu vamshaavali yidhe.
ishmaayelu jyeshthakumaarudaina nebaayothu kedaaru adbayelu mibshaamu
mishmaa doomaanamashshaa
hadaru themaa yethooru naapeeshu kedemaa

ivi vaari vaari vamshaavalula prakaaramu vaari vaari perula choppuna ishmaayelu kumaarula yokka perulu vaari vaari graamamulalonu vaari vaari kotalalonu ishmaayelu kumaarulu veere, vaari perulu ive, vaarivaari janamula prakaaramu vaaru pandrenduguru raajulu.
ishmaayelu bradhikina samvatsaramulu noota muppadhi yedu. Appudathadu praanamuvidichi mruthibondi thana pitharula yoddhaku cherchabadenu.
vaaru ashshoorunaku vellu maargamuna haveelaa modalukoni aigupthu edutanunna shooruvaraku nivasinchuvaaru athadu thana sahodarulandari yeduta nivaasa merparachukonenu.
abraahaamu kumaarudagu issaaku vamshaavali yidhe. Abraahaamu issaakunu kanenu.
issaaku paddhanaraamulo nivasinchu siriyaa vaadaina bethooyelu kumaartheyunu siriyaa vaadaina laabaanu sahodariyunaina ribkaanu pendli chesikonnappudu nalubadhi samvatsaramulavaadu.
issaaku bhaarya godraalu ganuka athadu aame vishayamai yehovaanu vedukonenu. Yehovaa athani praarthana vinenu ganuka athani bhaaryayaina ribkaa garbhavathi aayenu.
aame garbhamulo shishuvulu okanithoo nokadu penugulaadiri ganuka aame eelaagaithe nenu bradukuta yendukani anukoni yee vishayamai yehovaanu aduga vellenu. Appudu yehovaa aamethoo nitlanenu
rendu janamulu nee garbhamulo kalavu.Rendu janapadamulu nee kadupulo nundi pratyekamugaa vachunu. Oka janapadamu kante oka janapadamu balishtamai yundunu. Peddavaadu chinnavaaniki daasudagunu anenu.
aame prasoothi kaavalasina dinamulu nindinappudu aame garbhamandu kavalavaaru undiri.
modativaadu erranivaadugaa bayatikivacchenu. Athani ollanthayu roma vastramuvale nundenu ganuka athaniki eshaavu anu peru pettiri.

tharuvaatha athani sahodarudu bayatiki vachinappudu athani cheyyi eshaavu madimenu pattukoni yundenu ganuka athaniki yaakobu anu peru petta badenu. aame vaarini kaninappudu issaaku aruvadhi yendlavaadu.
aa chinnavaaru ediginappudu eshaavu vetaadutayandu nerpariyai aranyavaasigaa nundenu; yaakobu saadhuvai gudaaramulalo nivasinchuchundenu.
issaaku eshaavu techina veta maansamunu thinuchundenu ganuka athani preminchenu; ribkaa yaakobunu preminchenu.
okanaadu yaakobu kalagoora vantakamu vandukonuchundagaa eshaavu alasinavaadai polamulonundi vachi
-nenu alasiyunnaanu; aa yerrayerragaa nunna daanilo konchemu dayachesi naaku pettumani adigenu; anduchetha athani peru edomu anabadenu.
anduku yaakobu -nee jyeshthatvamu nedu naakimmani adugagaa
eshaavu -nenu chaavabovuchunnaanu gadaa jyeshthatvamu naakendukanenu
yaakobu-nedu naathoo pramaanamu cheyumanenu. Athadu yaakobuthoo pramaanamuchesi athaniki jyeshthatvamunu ammiveyagaa
yaakobu aahaaramunu chikkudukaayala vantakamunu eshaavu kicchenu; athadu thini traagi lechipoyenu. Atlu eshaavu thana jyeshthatvamunu truneekarinchenu.
abraahaamu dinamulalo vachina modati karavu gaaka mariyoka karavu aa dheshamulo vacchenu. Appadu issaaku geraarulonunna philishtheeyula raajaina abeemeleku noddhaku vellenu.
akkada yehovaa athaniki pratyakshamai neevu aigupthuloniki vellaka nenu neethoo cheppu dheshamandu nivasinchumu.
ee dheshamandu paravaasivai yundumu. Nenu neeku thoodaiyundi ninnu aasheervadhinchedanu;

yelayanagaa neekunu nee santhaanamunakunu ee dheshamulanniyu ichi, nee thandriyaina abraahaamuthoo nenu chesina pramaanamu neraverchi, aakaasha nakshatramulavale nee santhaanamunu vistharimpachesi ee dheshamulanniyu nee santhaanamunaku icchedanu. nee santhaanamuvalana samastha bhoolokamuloni samastha janulu aasheervadhimpabaduduru.
yelayanagaa abraahaamu naa maata vini nenu vidhinchina daani naa aagna lanu naa kattadalanu naa niyamamulanu gaikonenani cheppenu.
issaaku geraarulo nivasinchenu.

aa chooti manushyulu athani bhaaryanu chuchi- aame yevarani adiginappudu athadu'aame naa sahodari ani cheppenu; endukanagaa- ribkaa chakkanidi ganuka ee chooti manushyulu aame nimitthamu nannu champuduremo anukoni thana bhaarya ani chepputaku bhayapadenu.
akkada athadu chaalaa dinamulundina tharuvaatha philishtheeyula raajaina abeemeleku kitikeelo nundi chuchinappudu issaaku thana bhaaryayaina ribkaathoo sarasamaaduta kanabadenu.
appudu abeemeleku issaakunu pilipinchi idigo aame nee bhaaryaye'aame naa sahodari ani yela cheppithivani adugagaa issaaku'aamenu batti nenu chanipovudu nemo anukontinani athanithoo cheppenu.
anduku abeemeleku neevu maaku chesina yee pani yemi? ee janulalo evadaina aamethoo nirbhayamugaa shayaninchavachune. Appudu neevu maameediki paathakamu techipettu vaadavugadaa anenu.
abeemeleku'ee manushyuni jolikainanu ithani bhaarya jolikainanu vellu vaadu nishchayamugaa maranashiksha pondunani thana prajala kandariki aagnaapimpagaa
issaaku aa dheshamandunnavaadai vitthanamu vesi aa samvatsaramu nooranthalu phalamu pondhenu. Yehovaa athanini aasheervadhinchenu ganuka aa manushyudu goppavaadaayenu.
athadu mikkili goppavaadaguvaraku krama kramamugaa abhivruddhi ponduchu vacchenu.
athaniki gorrela aasthiyu godla aasthiyu daasulu goppa samooha munu kaliginanduna philishtheeyulu athaniyandu asooya padiri.
athani thandriyaina abraahaamu dinamulalo athani thandri daasulu travvina baavulannitini philishtheeyulu mannu posi poodchivesiri.
abeemeleku neevu maakante bahu balamu galavaadavu ganuka maayoddhanundi vellipommani issaaku thoo cheppagaa
issaaku akkadanundi velli geraaru loyalo gudaaramu vesikoni akkada nivasinchenu.

appudu thana thandriyaina abraahaamu dinamulalo travvina neella baavulu issaaku thirigi travvinchenu; yelayanagaa abraa haamu mruthibondina tharuvaatha philishtheeyulu vaatini poodchivesiri. Athadu thana thandri vaatiki pettina pella choppuna thirigi vaatiki perlu pettenu.
mariyu issaaku daasulu aa loyalo travvagaa jelalugala neellabaavi dorikenu.
appudu geraaru kaaparulu issaaku kaaparulathoo jagadamaadi ee neeru maadhe ani cheppiri ganuka vaaru thanathoo kalahinchinanduna athadu aa baaviki esheku anu peru pettenu.
vaaru mariyoka baavi travvinappudu daanikorakunu jagadamaadiri ganuka daaniki shitnaa anu peru pettenu.

athadu akkadanundi velli mariyoka baavi travvinchenu. daani vishayamai vaaru jagada maadaledu ganuka athadu ippudu yehovaa manaku edamu kalugajesiyunnaadu ganuka yee dheshamandu abhivruddhi pondudumanukoni daaniki rahebothu anu peru pettenu.
akkadanundi athadu beyershebaaku vellenu.

aa raatriye yehovaa athaniki pratyakshamai nenu nee thandriyaina abraahaamu dhevudanu, nenu neeku thoodaiyunnaanu ganuka bhayapadakumu; naa daasudaina abraahaamunu batti ninnu aasheervadhinchi nee santhaanamunu vistharimpachesedhanani cheppenu.
akkada athadoka balipeethamu kattinchi yehovaa naamamuna praarthanachesi akkada thana gudaaramu vesenu. Appudu issaaku daasulu akkada baavi travviri.
anthata abeemelekunu athani snehithudaina ahujathunu athani senaadhipathiyaina pheekolunu geraarunundi athaniyoddhaku vachiri.
issaakumeeru naameeda pagapatti meeyoddhanundi nannu pampivesina tharuvaatha endunimitthamu naa yoddhaku vachiyunnaarani vaarinadugagaa
vaaru nishchayamugaa yehovaa neeku thoodaiyunduta chuchithivi ganuka manaku, anagaa maakunu neekunu madhya noka pramaanamundavale naniyu

memu ninnu muttaka neeku mele thappa maremiyu cheyaka ninnu samaadhaanamugaa pampi vesithivi ganuka neevunu maaku keeducheyakundunatlu neethoo nibandhana chesikondumaniyu anukontimi; ippudu neevu yehovaa aasheervaadamu pondina vaadavaniri.
athadu vaariki vinducheyagaa vaaru annapaanamulu puchu koniri.
tellavaarinappudu vaaru lechi okanithoo okadu pramaanamu chesikoniri; tharuvaatha issaaku vaarini saaganampagaa vaaru athani yoddhanundi samaadhaanamugaa velliri.
aa dinamandhe issaaku daasulu vachi thaamu travvina baavinigoorchi athaniki teliyachesi maaku neellu kanabadinavani cheppiri ganuka
daaniki sheba anu peru pettenu. Kaabatti neti varaku aa oori peru beyershebaa.
eshaavu naluvadhi samvatsaramulavaadainappudu hittheeyudaina beyeree kumaartheyagu yahoodeethunu hittheeyudaina elonu kumaartheyagu baashemathunu pendlichesikonenu.
veeru issaakunakunu ribkaakunu manovedhana kalugajesiri.
issaaku vruddhudai athani kannulaku mandadrushti kaliginappudu athadu thana pedda kumaarudaina eshaavuthoo naa kumaarudaa, ani athani piluvagaa athadu chitthamu naayanaa ani athanithoo nanenu.
appudu issaaku idigo nenu vruddhudanu, naa maranadhinamu naaku teliyadu.
kaabatti neevu dayachesi nee aayudhamulaina nee ambula podhini nee villunu theesikoni adaviki poyi naakoraku vetaadi maansamu temmu.
nenu chaavaka munupu ninnu nenu aasheervadhinchunatlu naakishtamaina ruchigala bhojyamulanu siddhaparachi nenu thinutakai naayoddhaku temmani cheppenu.
issaaku thana kumaarudagu eshaavuthoo itlu cheppuchundagaa ribkaa vinuchundenu. eshaavu vetaadi maansamu techutaku adaviki vellenu.
appudu ribkaa thana kumaarudagu yaakobunu chuchi idigo nee thandri nee annayaina eshaavuthoo
mruthi bondakamunupu nenu thini yehovaa sannidhini ninnu aasheervadhinchunatlu naakoraku maansamu techi naaku ruchigala bhojyamulanu siddha parachumani cheppagaa vintini.
kaabatti naa kumaarudaa, naa maata vini nenu neeku aagnaa pinchinattu cheyumu.
neevu mandaku velli rendu manchi meka pillalanu akkadanundi naayoddhaku temmu. Vaatithoo nee thandri kishtamaina ruchigala bhojyamulanu athaniki chesedanu.
nee thandri mruthibondaka mundu athadu vaatini thini ninnu aasheervadhinchunatlu neevu vaatini nee thandri yoddhaku theesikonipovalenanenu.
anduku yaakobu naa sahodarudaina eshaavu romamu galavaadu, nenu nunnanivaadanu gadaa.
okavela naathandri nannu thadavichoochunu, appudu nenu athani drushtiki vanchakudanugaa thoochinayedala naa meediki shaapame gaani aasheervaadamu techukonanani cheppenu.
ayinanu athani thallinaa kumaarudaa, aa shaapamu naa meediki vachunugaaka. neevu naa maatamaatramu vini, poyi vaatini naayoddhaku theesikoni rammani cheppagaa
athadu velli vaatini thana thalliyoddhaku theesikonivacchenu. Athani thalli athani thandri kishtamaina ruchigala bhojyamulanu siddhapaṟachenu.
mariyu thana jyeshtha kumaarudagu eshaavunaku sogasaina vastramulu inta thana yoddha nundenu ganuka
ribkaa vaatini theesi thana chinna kumaarudagu yaakobunaku todiginchi aa mekapillala charmamulathoo athani chethulanu athani medameeda nunupu bhaagamunu kappi
thaanu siddhaparachina ruchigala bhojyamulanu rottenu thana kumaarudagu yaakobu chethi kiyyagaa
athadu thana thandriyoddhaku vachinaa thandree, ani piluvagaa athadu emi naa kumaarudaa, nee vevaravani adigenu

anduku yaakobu nenu eshaavu anu nee jyeshthakumaarudanu, neevu naathoo cheppina prakaaramu chesiyunnaanu. neevu nannu deevinchutakai dayachesi lechikoorchundi, nenu vetaadi techinadaanini thinumanenu.
appudu issaaku naa kumaarudaa, intha sheeghramugaa adhi nee ketlu dorikenani adugagaa athadunee dhevudaina yehovaa naa yedutiki daani rappinchutachethane ani cheppenu.
appudu issaaku naa kumaarudaa, neevu eshaavanu naa kumaarudavo kaavo nenu ninnu thadavi chuchedanu daggaraku rammani cheppenu.
yaakobu thana thandriyaina issaaku daggaraku vachinappudu athadu athani thadavichuchi-svaramu yaakobu svaramu gaani chethulu eshaavu chethule anenu.
yaakobu chethulu athani annayaina eshaavu chethulavale romamu galavainanduna issaaku athanini guruthu pattaleka athanini deevinchi
eshaavu anu naa kumaarudavu neevenaa ani adugagaa yaakobu-nene anenu.
anthata athadu adhi naayoddhaku temmu; nenu ninnu deevinchunatlu naa kumaarudu vetaadi techinadhi thindu nanenu; athadu techinappudu athadu thinenu; draakshaarasamu thegaa athadu traagenu.
tharuvaatha athani thandriyaina issaaku naa kumaarudaa, daggarakuvachi nannu muddu pettukommani athanithoo cheppenu.

athadu daggaraku vachi athani muddupettukonenu. Appudathadu athani vastramulanu vaasana chuchi athani deevinchi yitlanenu. Idigo naa kumaaruni suvaasana yehovaa deevinchina cheni suvaasanavale nunnadhi.
aakaashapumanchunu bhoosaaramunu visthaaramaina dhaanyamunu draakshaarasamunu dhevudu nee kanugrahinchugaaka

janamulu neeku daasulaguduru janamulu neeku saagilapaduduru nee bandhujanulaku neevu elikavai yundumu nee thalli putrulu neeku saagilapaduduru ninnu shapinchuvaaru shapimpabaduduru ninnu deevinchuvaaru deevimpabadudurugaaka
issaaku yaakobunu deevinchutayaina tharuvaatha yaakobu thana thandriyaina issaaku edutanundi bayalu dheri vellina thakshaname athani sahodarudaina eshaavu vetaadi vacchenu.
athadunu ruchigala bhojyamulanu siddhaparachi thana thandriyoddhaku techinaa thandree nannu deevinchunatlu lechi nee kumaarudu vetaadi techinadaani thinumani thana thandrithoonanenu.
athani thandriyaina issaaku-nee vevaravani athani nadiginappudu athadunenu nee kumaarudanu eshaavu anu nee jyeshthakumaarudananagaa

issaaku mikkutamugaa gadagada vanakuchu atlayithe vetaadina bhojyamunu naayoddhaku techinavaarevaru? neevu raakamunupu nenu vaatannitilo thini athanini nijamugaa deevinchithini, athadu deevimpabadinavaade yanenu.
eshaavu thana thandri maatalu vininappudu duḥkhaakraanthudai peddakeka vesi - o naa thandree, nannunu deevinchumani thana thandrithoo cheppenu.
athadu-nee sahodarudu kapatopaayamuthoo vachi neeku raavalasina deevena theesikonipoyenu.

eshaavu yaakobu anu peru athaniki sarigaane chellinadhi; athadu nannu ee rendu maarulu mosapucchenu. Naa jyeshthatvamu theesikonenu, idigo ippudu vachi naaku raavalasina deevenanu theesikonenani cheppi- naa koraku mari ye deevenayu migilchi yunchaledaa ani adigenu.

anduku issaaku-idigo athani neeku elikanugaa niyaminchi athani bandhujanulandarini athaniki daasulugaa ichithini; dhaanyamunu draakshaarasamunu ichi athani poshinchithini ganuka naa kumaarudaa, neekemi cheyavalenani eshaavuthoo pratyuttharamiyyagaa¸
eshaavu naa thandree, neeyoddha oka deevenaye unnadaa? Naa thandree, nannu, nannu kooda deevinchumani thana thandrithoo cheppi eshaavu elugetthi yedvagaa athani thandriyaina issaaku-
nee nivaasamu bhoosaaramu lekayu painundipadu aakaashapu manchu lekayu nundunu.
neevu neekatthichetha bradukuduvu nee sahodaruniki daasudavaguduvu neevu thirugulaadu chundagaa nee medameedanundi athanikaadi virichiveyuduvu ani athani kuttharamicchenu.

thana thandri yaakobukichina deevena nimitthamu eshaavu athanimeeda pagapattenu. Mariyu eshaavu naa thandrini goorchina duḥkhadhinamulu sameepamugaa nunnavi; appudu naa thammudaina yaakobunu champedhananukonenu.

ribkaa thana peddakumaarudaina eshaavu maatalanugoorchi vininappudu aame thana chinna kumaarudaina yaakobunu piluvanampi athanithoo itlanenu-idigo nee annayaina eshaavu ninnu champedhanani cheppi ninnu goorchi thannuthaanu odaarchukonu chunnaadu.
kaabatti naa kumaarudaa, neevu naa maata vini lechi haaraanulonunna naa sahodarudagu laabaanu noddhaku paaripoyi nee annakopamu challaaruvaraku
nee anna kopamu neemeedanundi tolagi neevu athaniki chesina vaatini athadu marachuvaraku laabaanunoddha konnaallu undumu;
appudu nenu akkadanundi ninnu pilipinchedanu. Okkanaade mee yiddarini nenu pogottukonanela anenu.

mariyu ribkaa issaakuthoo - hethu kumaarthelavalana naa praanamu visikinadhi. ee dheshasthuraandrayina hethu kumaarthelalo veerivanti okadaanini yaakobu pendli chesi koninayedala naa bradukuvalana naakemi prayojanamanenu.
issaaku yaakobunu pilipinchi- neevu kanaanu kumaarthelalo evatenu vivaahamu chesikonakoodadu.
neevu lechi paddhanaraamulonunna nee thalliki thandriyaina bethooyelu intiki velli akkada nee thalli sahodarudagu laabaanu kumaarthelalo okadaanini vivaahamu chesikonumani yathaniki aagnaapinchi

sarvashakthigala dhevudu ninnu aasheervadhinchi neevu aneka janamulagunatlu neeku santhaanaabhivruddhi kalugajesi ninnu vistharimpajesi neevu paravaasivaina dhesha munu, anagaa dhevudu abraahaamunakichina dheshamunu,neevu svaasthyamugaa chesikonunatlu
aayana neeku, anagaa neekunu neethoo kooda nee santhaanamunakunu abraahaamunaku anugrahinchina aasheervaadamunu dayacheyunugaaka ani athani deevinchi yaakobunu pampivesenu.
Athadu paddhanaraamulonunna siriyaavaadagu bethooyelu kumaarudunu, yaakobu eshaavula thalliyagu ribkaa sahodarudunaina laabaanunoddhaku vellenu.

issaaku yaakobunu deevinchi, paddhanaraamulo pendlichesikoni vachutakai athani nakkadiki pampenaniyu, athani deevinchinappudu neevu kanaanu dheshapu kumaarthelalo evarini pendli chesikonavaddani athaniki aagnaapinchenaniyu
yaakobu thana thallidandrula maata vini paddhanaraamunaku velli poyenaniyu eshaavu telisikoninappudu,
idigaaka kanaanu kumaarthelu thana thandriyaina issaakunaku ishturaandru kaarani eshaavunaku telisinappudu
eshaavu ishmaayelu noddhaku velli, thanakunna bhaaryalugaaka abraahaamu kumaarudaina ishmaayelu kumaartheyu nebaayothu sahodariyunaina mahalathunu kooda pendli chesikonenu.
yaakobu beyershebaanundi bayaludheri haaraanu vaipu velluchu
okachoota cheri proddu grunkinanduna akkada aa raatri nilichipoyi, aa chooti raallalo okati theesikoni thanaku thalagadagaa chesikoni, akkada pandu konenu.
appudathadu oka kala kanenu. Andulo oka nicchena bhoomimeeda nilupabadiyundenu; daani kona aakaashamunantenu; daanimeeda dhevuni doothalu ekkuchu diguchunundiri.
mariyu yehovaa daaniki paigaa nilichinenu nee thandriyaina abraahaamu dhevudanu issaaku dhevudaina yehovaanu; neevu pandukoniyunna yee bhoomini neekunu nee santhaanamunakunu icchedanu.

nee santhaanamu bhoomimeeda lekkaku isuka renuvulavalenagunu; neevu padamati thattunu thoorputhattunu uttharapu thattunu dakshinapu thattunu vyaapinchedavu, bhoomiyokka vanshamulanniyu nee moolamugaanu nee santhaanamu moolamugaanu aasheervadhimpabadunu.
idigo nenu neeku thoodai yundi, neevu vellu prathi sthalamandu ninnu kaapaaduchu ee dheshamunaku ninnu marala rappinchedanu; nenu neethoo cheppinadhi neraverchuvaraku ninnu viduvanani cheppagaa
yaakobu nidra telisi nishchayamugaa yehovaa ee sthalamandunnaadu; adhi naaku teliyaka poyenanukoni
bhayapadi ee sthalamu enthoo bhayankaramu. Idi dhevuni mandirame gaani verokati kaadu;
paralokapu gavini idhe anukonenu. Tellavaarinappudu yaakobu lechi thaanu thalagadagaa chesikonina raayitheesi daanini sthambhamugaa nilipi daani konameeda noone posenu.
mariyu athadu aa sthalamunaku bethelanu peru pettenu. Ayithe modata aa oori peru looju.
appudu yaakobu nenu thirigi naa thandri yintiki kshemamugaa vachunatlu dhevudu naaku thoodaiyundi, nenu velluchunna yee maargamulo nannu kaapaadi,
thinutaku aahaaramunu dharinchukonutaku vastramulanu naaku dayachesina yedala yehovaa naaku dhevudai yundunu.
mariyu sthambhamugaa nenu nilipina yee raayi dhevuni mandiramagunu; mariyu neevu naa kichu yaavatthulo padhiyavavanthu nishchayamugaa neeku chellinchedhanani mrokku konenu.
yaakobu bayaludheri thoorpu janula dheshamunaku vellenu.

athadu chuchinappudu polamulo oka baavi kanabadenu. Akkada daaniyoddha gorrela mandalu moodu pandukoni yundenu; kaaparulu mandalaku aa baavi neellu pettuduru; oka pedda raayi aa baavimeeda moothavesi yundenu.
akkadiki mandalanniyu koodi vachunappudu baavimeedanundi aa raathini porlinchi, gorrelaku neellu petti thirigi baavimeedi raathini daani chootanunchuduru.
yaakobu vaarini chuchi annalaaraa, mee rekkadivaarani adugagaa vaaru memu haaraanuvaara maniri.
athadu-naahoru kumaarudagu laabaanunu meereruguduraa ani vaarinadugagaa vaaru erugudumaniri.
mariyu athadu athadu kshemamugaa unnaadaa ani adugagaa vaaru kshemamugaane unnaadu; idigo athani kumaartheyaina raahelu gorrelaventa vachuchunnadani cheppiri.
athadu-idigo inka chaalaa proddu unnadhi, pashuvu lanu pogucheyu velakaaledu, gorrelaku neellu petti, poyi vaatini mepudani cheppagaa
vaarumanda lanniyu pogukaakamunupu adhi maavalana kaadu, tharuvaatha baavimeedanundi raayi porlinchuduru; appude memu gorrelaku neellu pettudumaniri.
athadu vaarithoo inka maatalaaduchundagaa raahelu thana thandri gorrela mandanu thoolukoni vacchenu; aame vaatini mepunadhi.

yaakobu thana thalli sahodarudaina laabaanu kumaartheyagu raahelunu, thana thalli sahodarudagu laabaanu gorrelanu chuchinappudu athadu daggaraku velli baavimeedanundi raathini porlinchi thana thalli sahodarudagu laabaanu gorrelaku neellu pettenu. Yaakobu raahelunu muddupettukoni yelugetthi yedchenu.
mariyu yaakobu thaanu aame thandri bandhuvudaniyu,
ribkaa kumaarudaniyu raaheluthoo cheppinappudu aame parugetthipoyi thana thandrithoo cheppenu.

laabaanu thana sahodari kumaarudaina yaakobu samaachaaramu vininappudu athanini edurkonutaku parugetthikoni vachi athani kaugalinchi muddu pettukoni thana yintiki thoodukoni poyenu. Athadu ee sangathulanniyu laabaanuthoo cheppenu.
appudu laabaanu nijamugaa neevu naa emukayu naa maansamunai yunnaavu anenu. Athadu nela dinamulu athaniyoddha nivasinchina tharuvaatha
laabaanu neevu naa bandhuvudavainanduna oorakaye naaku koluvu chesedavaa? neekemi jeethamu kaavaleno cheppumani yaakobu nadigenu.
laabaanu kiddaru kumaarthelundiri. Vaarilo peddadaani peru leyaa; chinnadaani peru raahelu.
leyaa jabbu kandlu galadhi; raahelu roopavathiyu sundariyunai yundenu.
yaakobu raahelunu preminchi nee chinna kumaartheyaina raahelu kosamu neeku edu samvatsaramulu koluvu chesedhananenu.
anduku laabaanu aamenu anyunikichutakante neekichuta melu; naayoddha undumani cheppagaa
yaakobu raahelu kosamu edu samvatsaramulu koluvu chesenu. Ayinanu athadu aamenu preminchutavalana avi athaniki koddi dinamulugaa thoochenu.
tharuvaatha yaakobu naa dinamulu sampoornamainavi ganuka nenu naa bhaaryayoddhaku povunatlu aamenu naakimmani laabaanu nadugagaa
laabaanu aa sthalamulonunna manushyula nandarini poguchesi vindu cheyinchi
raatri vela thana kumaartheyaina leyaanu athaniyoddhaku theesikoni pogaa yaakobu aamenu koodenu.
mariyu laabaanu thana daasiyaina jilpaanu thana kumaartheyaina leyaaku daasigaa icchenu.
udayamandu aamenu leyaa ani yerigi athadu laabaanuthoo neevu naaku chesina pani yemiti? Raahelu kosame gadaa neeku koluvu chesithini? Enduku nannu mosapuchithivanenu.
anduku laabaanu pedda daanikante mundhugaa chinnadaani nichuta maadhesha maryaadakaadu.
eeme yokka vaaramu sampoornamu cheyumu; neevika yedu samvatsaramulu naaku koluvu chesinayedala andukai aamenu kooda neekicchedamani cheppagaa
yaakobu alaagu chesi aame vaaramu sampoorthiyaina tharuvaatha athadu thana kumaartheyaina raahelunu athaniki bhaaryagaa icchenu.
mariyu laabaanu thana daasiyagu bil'haanu thana kumaartheyaina raaheluku daasigaa icchenu.
yaakobu raahelunu koodenu, mariyu athadu leyaakante raahelunu bahugaa preminchi athaniki mariyedendlu koluvu chesenu.
leyaa dveshimpabaduta yehovaa chuchi aame garbhamu terichenu, raahelu godraalai yundenu.
leyaa garbhavathiyai kumaaruni kani, yehovaa naa shramanu chuchiyunnaadu ganuka naa penimiti nannu preminchunu gadaa anukoni athaniki roobenu anu peru pettenu.
aame marala garbhavathiyai kumaaruni kani nenu dveshimpabadithinanna sangathi yehovaa vinnaadu ganuka ithanikooda naaku dayachesenanukoni athaniki shimyonu anu peru pettenu.
aame marala garbhavathiyai kumaaruni kani thudaku ee saari naa penimiti naathoo hatthukoni yundunu; athaniki mugguru kumaarulanu kantinanukonenu. Anduchetha athaniki levi anu peru pettenu
aame marala garbhavathiyai kumaaruni kani ee-saari yehovaanu sthuthinchedhananukoni yoodhaa anu peru pettenu. Appudaameku kaanupu udigenu.
raahelu thaanu yaakobunaku pillalu kanaka povuta chuchi thana akkayandu asooyapadi yaakobuthoo-naaku garbhaphalamunimmu; leniyedala nenu chacchedhananenu.
yaakobu kopamu raahelumeeda ragulukonagaa athadu-nenu neeku garbhaphalamunu iyyaka poyina dhevuniki prathigaa nunnaanaa anenu.
andukaame - naa daasiyaina bil'haa unnadhi gadaa; aamethoo pommu; aame naa koraku pillalanu kanunu; aalaaguna aame valana naakunu pillalu kalugudurani cheppi
thana daasiyaina bil'haanu athaniki bhaaryagaa icchenu. Yaakobu aamethoo pogaa
bil'haa garbhavathiyai yaakobunaku kumaaruni kanenu.
appudu raahelu dhevudu naaku theerputheerchenu; aayana naa moranu vini naaku kumaaruni daya chesenanukoni athaniki daanu ani peru pettenu.
raahelu daasiyaina bil'haa thirigi garbhavathiyai yaakobuku rendava kumaaruni kanenu.
appudu raahelu dhevuni krupa vishayamai naa akkathoo poraadi gelichithinanukoni athaniki naphthaali anu peru pettenu.
leyaa thanaku kaanupu uduguta chuchi thana daasiyaina jilpaanu theesikoni yaakobunaku aamenu bhaaryagaa icchenu.
leyaa daasiyaina jilpaa yaakobunaku kumaaruni kanagaa
leyaa-idi adrushtamegadaa anukoni athaniki gaadu anu perupettenu.
leyaa daasiyaina jilpaa yaakobunaku rendava kumaaruni kanagaa
leyaa nenu bhaagyavanthuraalanu-streelu nannu bhaagyavathi anduru gadaa ani athaniki aasheru anu peru pettenu.

godhumala kothakaalamulo roobenu velli polamulo putradaatha vrukshapu pandlu chuchi thana thalliyaina leyaaku techi yicchenu. Appudu raahelu-nee kumaaruni putra daathavrukshapu pandlalo konni naaku dayacheyumani leyaathoo anagaa

aame-naa bharthanu theesikontive adhi chaaladaa? Ippudu naa kumaaruni putradaatha vrukshapu pandlanu theesikonduvaa ani cheppenu. Anduku raahelu-kaabatti nee kumaaruni putradaatha vrukshapu pandla nimitthamu athadu ee raatri neethoo shayaninchunani cheppenu.

saayankaalamandu yaakobu polamu nundi vachunappudu leyaa athanini edurkona boyi-neevu naa yoddhaku raavalenu, naa kumaaruni putradaathavrukshapu pandlathoo ninnu kontinani cheppenu. Kaabatti athadu aa raatri aamethoo shayaninchenu.
dhevudu leyaa manavi vinenu ganuka aame garbhavathiyai yaakobunaku ayidava kumaaruni kanenu.
leyaa nenu naa penimitiki naa daasi nichinanduna dhevudu naaku prathiphalamu dayachesenanukoni athaniki ishshaakhaaru anu peru pettenu.
leyaa marala garbhavathiyai yaakobunaku aarava kumaaruni kanenu.
appudu leyaa dhevudu manchi bahumathi naaku dayachesenu; naa penimitiki aaruguru kumaarulanu kaniyunnaanu ganuka athadikanu naathoo kaapuramu cheyunanukoni athaniki jebooloonu anu peru pettenu.
aa tharuvaatha aame komaartenu kani aameku deenaa anu peru pettenu.
dhevudu raahelunu gnaapakamu chesikoni aame manavi vini aame garbhamu terichenu.
appudaame garbhavathiyai kumaaruni kani-dhevudu naa ninda tolaginchenanukonenu.
mariyu aame-yehovaa mariyoka kumaaruni naaku dayacheyunugaaka anukoni athaniki yosepu anu peru pettenu.
raahelu yosepunu kanina tharuvaatha yaakobu laabaanuthoo-nannu pampiveyumu; naa chootikini naa dheshamunakunu velledanu.
naa bhaaryalanu naa pillalanu naakappaginchumu; appudu nenu velledanu; vaari kosamu neeku koluvuchesithini; nenu neeku koluvu chesina vidhamunu nee veruguduvugadaa ani cheppenu.
anduku laabaanu athanithoo nee kataakshamu naa meedanunna yedala naa maata vinumu; ninnu batti yehovaa nannu aasheervadhinchenani shakunamu chuchi telisikontinani cheppenu.
mariyu athadu nee jeethaminthayani naathoo spashtamugaa cheppumu adhi yicchedhananenu.
anduku yaakobu athani chuchi nenu neeketlu koluvu chesithino nee mandalu naayoddha etlundeno adhi neeku teliyunu;

nenu raakamunupu neekundinadhi koncheme; ayithe adhi bahugaa abhivruddhi pondhenu; nenu paadamupettina chootella yehovaa ninnu aasheervadhinchenu; nenu naa yinti vaarikoraku eppudu sampaadyamu chesikondunanenu.
appuda thadu nenu neekemi iyyavalenani yadiginanduku yaakobuneevu naakemiyu iyyavaddu; neevu naakoraku ee vidhamugaa chesinayedala nenu thirigi nee mandanu mepi kaachedanu.

nedu nenu nee manda anthatilo nadachi chuchi podalainanu macchalainanu gala prathi gorranu, gorrapillalalo nallani prathidaanini, mekalalo macchalainanu podalainanu galavaatini veruparachedanu; attivi naaku jeethamagunu.

ikameedata naaku raavalasina jeethamunu goorchi neevu choodavachi nappudu naa nyaayapravarthanaye naaku saakshyamagunu; mekalalo podalainanu macchalainanu lenivanniyu, gorrepillalalo nalupu lenivanniyu naa yoddhanunnayedala nenu dongilithinani cheppavachunanenu.
anduku laabaanu manchidi, nee maatachoppunane kaanimmanenu.

aa dinamuna laabaanu chaarayainanu macchayainanu gala mekapothulanu, podalainanu macchalainanu gala pentimekalannitini konchemu telupugala prathidaanini gorrepillalalo nallavaati nannitini veruchesi thana kumaarula chethi kappaginchi
thanakunu yaakobunakunu madhya moodu dinamula prayaanamantha dooramu pettenu; laabaanuyokka migilina mandanu yaakobu mepu chundenu.
yaakobu chinaaru jangi saalu anu chetla chuvvalanu theesikoni aa chuvvalalo tellachaaralu kanabadunatlu akkadakkada vaati tokkalu olichi
mandalu neellu traaga vachinappudu avi choolu kattutaku athadu thaanu olichina chuvvalanu mandalu traagutaku vachu kaaluvalalonu neellagaallalonu vaatiyeduta pettagaa
mandalu aa chuvvala yeduta choolu katti chaaralainanu podalainanu macchalainanu gala pillalanu eenenu.

yaakobu aa gorrapillalanu veruchesi, chaaralugala vaati thattunu laabaanu mandalalo nallani vaati thattunu mandala mukhamulu trippi thana mandalanu laabaanu mandalathoo nunchaka vaatini verugaa unchenu.
mandalo balamainavi choolu kattinappudellanu avi aa chuvvala yeduta choolu kattunatlu yaakobu manda kannula yeduta kaaluvalalo aa chuvvalu pettenu.
manda balaheenamainappudu pettaledu. Atlu balaheenamainavi laabaanukunu balamainavi yaakobu nakunu vacchenu.
aa prakaaramu aa manushyudu atyadhikamugaa abhivruddhipondi visthaaramaina mandalu daaseelu daasulu ontelu gaadidalu galavaadaayenu.
laabaanu kumaarulu mana thandriki kaliginadhi yaavatthunu yaakobu theesikoni, mana thandriki kaligina daanivalana ee yaavadaasthi sampaadhinchenani cheppukonina maatalu yaakobu vinenu.
mariyu athadu laabaanu mukhamu chuchinappudu adhi ninna monna undinatlu athaniyedala undaledu.
appudu yehovaa nee pitharula dheshamunaku nee bandhuvula yoddhaku thirigi vellumu; nenu neeku thoodaiyundedhanani yaakobuthoo cheppagaa
yaakobu polamulo thana mandayoddhaku raahelunu leyaanu piluvanampi vaarithoo yitlanenu.
mee thandri kataakshamu ninna monna naameeda undinatlu ippudu naameeda nundaledani naaku kanabaduchunnadhi; ayithe naa thandriyokka dhevudu naaku thoodaiyunnaadu;
mee thandriki naa yaavacchakthithoo koluvu chesithinani meeku telise yunnadhi.
mee thandri nannu mosapuchi padhimaarlu naa jeethamu maarchenu; ayinanu dhevudu athani naaku haanicheya niyyaledu.

athadu podalu galavi nee jeethamagunani cheppinayedala appudu mandalanniyu podalugala pillalaneenenu. chaaralugalavi nee jeethamagunani cheppinayedala appudu mandalanniyu chaaralugala pillala neenenu.
atlu dhevudu mee thandri pashuvulanu theesi naakicchenu.
mandalu choolukattu kaalamuna nenu svapna mandu kannuletthi choodagaa gorrelanu daatu pottellu chaaralainanu podalainanu macchalainanu galavai yundenu.
mariyu aa svapnamandu dhevuni dootha yaakoboo ani nannu piluvagaa chitthamu prabhuvaa ani cheppithini.
appudu aayana nee kannuletthi choodumu; gorrelanu daatuchunna pottellanniyu chaaralainanu podalainanu macchalainanu galavi; yelayanagaa laabaanu neeku cheyuchunnadhi yaavatthunu chuchithini

nee vekkada sthambhamumeeda noone posithivo, yekkada naaku mrokkubadi chesithivo aa bethelu dhevudanu nene. Ippudu neevu lechi yee dheshamulonundi bayaludheri neevu puttina dheshamunaku thirigi vellumani naathoo cheppenanenu.
anduku raahelunu leyaayuyinka maa thandri yinta maaku paalu pampu lekkadivi? Athadu mammunu anyulugaa choochutaledaa?
athadu mammunu ammivesi, maaku raavalasina dravyamunu botthugaa thinivesenu.
dhevudu maa thandri yoddhanundi theesivesina dhanamanthayu maadhiyu maa pillaladhiyunaiyunnadhi gadaa? Kaabatti dhevudu neethoo cheppinatlella cheyumani athanikutthara miyyagaa
yaakobu lechi thana kumaarulanu thana bhaaryalanu ontelameeda nekkinchi

kanaanudheshamunaku thana thandriyaina issaaku noddhaku vellutaku thana pashuvu lannitini, thaanu sampaadhinchina sampada yaavatthunu, paddhanaraamulo thaanu sampaadhinchina aasthi yaavatthunu theesikoni poyenu.
laabaanu thana gorrelabochu katthirinchutaku velliyundagaa raahelu thana thandri yintanunna gruha dhevathalanu dongilenu.
yaakobu thaanu paaripovu chunnaanani siriyaavaadaina laabaanuku teliyacheyaka povuta valana athani mosapuchinavaadaayenu.
athadu thanaku kaligina danthayu theesikoni paaripoyenu. Athadu lechi nadhi daati gilaadanu kondathattu abhimukhudai vellenu.
yaakobu paaripoyenani moodava dinamuna laabaanuku telupabadenu.
athadu thana bandhuvulanu ventabettukoni, yedu dinamula prayaanamantha dooramu athani tharumukoni poyi, gilaadukonda meeda athani kalisikonenu.
aa raatri svapnamandu dhevudu siriyaavaadaina laabaanu noddhaku vachineevu yaakobuthoo manchigaani cheddagaani palukakumu jaagrattha sumee ani athanithoo cheppenu.
laabaanu yaakobunu kalisikonenu. Yaakobu thana gudaaramu aa kondameeda vesikoniyundenu; laabaanunu thana bandhuvulathoo gilaadu kondameeda gudaaramu vesi konenu.
appudu laabaanu yaakobuthoo neevemi chesithivi? Nannu mosapuchi, katthithoo cherapattabadina vaarini vale naa kumaarthelanu konipovanela?
neevu naaku cheppaka rahasyamugaa paaripoyi nannu mosapuchithivela? Sambhramamuthoonu paatalathoonu maddelathoonu sithaaraalathoonu ninnu saaganampudune.
ayithe neevu naa kumaarulanu naa kumaarthelanu nannu muddu pettu konaniyyaka pichipatti yitlu chesithivi.
meeku haani cheyutaku naa chethanavunu; ayithe poyina raatri mee thandriyokka dhevudu neevu yaakobuthoo manchi gaani cheddagaani palukakumu jaagrattha sumee ani naathoo cheppenu.
nee thandri yintimeeda bahu vaanchagala vaadavai vellagorina yedala vellumu, naa dhevathala nela dongilithivanagaa
yaakobu neevu balavanthamugaa naa yoddhanundi nee kumaarthelanu theesikonduvemo anukoni bhayapadithini

evariyoddha nee dhevathalu kanabaduno vaaru bradukakoodadu. neevu naa yoddhanunna vaatini mana bandhuvula yeduta vedaki nee daanini theesikonumani laabaanuthoo cheppenu. Raahelu vaatini dongilenani yaakobunaku teliyaledu.

laabaanu yaakobu gudaaramuloniki leyaa gudaaramu loniki iddari daaseela gudaaramulaloniki vellenu gaani athani kemiyu dorakaledu. tharuvaatha athadu leyaa gudaaramulonundi bayaludheri raahelu gudaaramuloniki vellenu.
raahelu aa vigrahamulanu theesikoni onte saamagrilo petti vaatimeeda koorchundenu. Kaagaa laabaanu aa gudaaramandanthatanu thadavi chuchi nappatikini avi dorakaledu.
aame thana thandrithoo thama yaduta nenu levalenanduna thaamu kopapadakoodadu; nenu kadagaa nunnaanani cheppenu. Atha dentha vedakinanu aa vigrahamulu dorakaledu.
yaakobu kopapadi laabaanuthoo vaadhinchi athanithoo neevitlu mandipadi nannu tharuma nela? Nenu chesina drohamemi? Paapamemi?

neevu naa samastha saamagri thadivi chuchina tharuvaatha nee yinti vasthuvulannitilo edi dorikenu? Naa vaari yedutanu nee vaariyedu tanu adhi yitlu techipettumu; vaaru mana ubhayula madhya theerpu theerchuduru.
ee yiruvadhi yendlu nenu neeyoddhanuntini. nee gorrelainanu meka lainanu eechu koni poledu, nee manda pottellanu nenu thinaledu.

dushta mrugamulachetha chilchabadinadaanini nee yoddhaku theka aa nashtamu nene pettukontini. Pagatiyandu dongilimpabadina daani nemi raatriyandu dongi limpabadinadaani nemi naayoddha puchukontivi; nenu eelaaguntini.
pagati yendakunu raatri manchukunu nenu ksheeninchipothini; nidra naa kannulaku doora maayenu.

idivaraku nee yintilo iruvadhi yendlu untini. nee yiddari kumaarthela nimitthamu padunaalu gendlunu, nee manda nimitthamu aarendlunu neeku koluvu chesithini. Ayinanu neevu naa jeethamu padhimaarulu maarchithivi.

naa thandri dhevudu, abraahaamu dhevudu, issaaku bhayapadina dhevudu naaku thoodaiyundaniyedala nishchayamugaa neevu nannu vatti chethulathoone pampivesi yunduvu. dhevudu naa prayaasamunu naa chethula kashtamunu chuchi, poyina raatri ninnu gaddinchenani laabaanuthoo cheppenu.

anduku laabaanu ee kumaarthelu naa kumaarthelu, ee kumaarulu naa kumaarulu, ee manda naa manda, neeku kanabaduchunnadhi anthayu naadhi, ee naa kumaarthelanainanu veeru kanina kumaarula nainanu nenemi cheyagalanu.
kaavuna nenunu neevunu nibandhana chesikondamu rammu, adhi naakunu neekunu madhya saakshigaa undunani yaakobuthoo uttharamiyyagaa
yaakobu oka raayi theesikoni daanini sthambhamugaa niluvabettenu.
mariyu yaakobu raallu koorchudani thana bandhuvulathoo cheppenu. Vaaru raallu techi kuppa vesiri; akkada vaaru aa kuppa yoddha bhojanamu chesiri.
laabaanu daaniki yagar‌ shaahadoothaa anu peru pettenu. Ayithe yaakobu daaniki galedu anu peru pettenu.

laabaanu nedu ee kuppa naakunu neekunu madhya saakshigaa undunani cheppenu. Kaabatti daaniki galedanu perupettenu. Mariyu manamu okarikokaramu dooramugaa nundagaa yehovaa naakunu neekunu madhya jarugunadhi kanipettunani cheppenu ganuka daaniki mispaa anu peru pettabadenu.
anthata laabaanuneevu naa kumaarthelanu baadha pettinanu, naa kumaarthelanu gaaka yithara streelanupendli chesikoninanu, choodumu,
manayoddha evarunu leru gadaa, naakunu neekunu dhevude saakshi ani cheppenu.
mariyu laabaanu naakunu neekunu madhya nenu nilipina yee sthambhamunu choodumu ee kuppa choodumu.
haanicheyavalenani nenu ee kuppa daati nee yoddhaku raakanu, neevu ee kuppanu ee sthambhamunu daati naa yoddhaku raakanu undutaku ee kuppa saakshi yee sthambhamunu saakshi.
abraahaamu dhevudu naahoru dhevudu vaari thandri dhevudu mana madhya nyaayamu theerchunani cheppenu. Appudu yaakobu thana thandriyaina issaaku bhayapadina dhevunithoodani pramaanamu chesenu.
yaakobu aa kondameeda bali yarpinchi bhojanamu cheyutaku thana bandhuvulanu piluvagaa vaaru bhojanamuchesi kondameeda aa raatri vellabuchiri.
tellavaarinappudu laabaanu lechi thana kumaarulanu thana kumaarthelanu muddu pettukoni vaarini deevinchi bayaludheri thana ooriki velli poyenu.
yaakobu thana trovanu velluchundagaa dhevadoothalu athanini edurkoniri.
yaakobu vaarini chuchi-idi dhevuni sena ani cheppi aa chootiki mahanayeemu anu peru pettenu.
yaakobu edomu dheshamuna, anagaa sheyeeru dheshamunanunna thana sahodarudaina eshaavunoddhaku doothalanu thanaku mundhugaa pampi-
meeru naa prabhuvaina eshaavuthoo inthavaraku nenu laabaanunoddha nivasinchi yuntini;

naaku pashuvulu gaadidalu mandalu daasadaaseejanamunu kalaru; nee kataakshamu naayandu kalugunatlugaa naa prabhuvunakidi teliyacheyanampithinani nee sevakudaina yaakobu anenani cheppudani vaari kaagnaapinchenu.
aa doothalu yaakobunoddhaku thirigivachi-memu nee sahodarudaina eshaavunoddhaku vellithivi; athadu naaluguvandalamandithoo ninnu edurkona vachuchunnaadani cheppagaa
yaakobu mikkili bhayapadi tondharapadi
-eshaavu oka gumpu meediki vachi daani hathamu chesinayedala migilina gumpu thappinchukonipovunanukoni, thanathoonunna janulanu mandalanu pashuvulanu ontelanu rendu gumpulugaa vibhaaginchenu.
appudu yaakobu-naa thandriyaina abraahaamu dhevaa, naa thandriyaina issaaku dhevaa-, nee dheshamunaku nee bandhuvulayoddhaku thirigi vellumu, neeku melu chesedhanani naathoo cheppina yehovaa,
neevu nee sevakuniki chesina samasthamaina upakaaramulakunu samastha satyamunakunu apaatrudanu, etlanagaa naa chethi karrathoo maatrame yee yordaanudaatithini; ippudu nenu rendu gumpulaithini.
naa sahodarudaina eshaavu chethinundi dayachesi nannu thappinchumu; athadu vachi pillalathoo thallini, nannu champunemo ani athaniki bhayapaduchunnaanu.
neevu nenu neeku thoodai nishchayamugaa melu cheyuchu, visthaaramagutavalana lekkimpaleni samudrapu isukavale nee santhaanamu vistharimpajeyudunani selavichithive anenu.
athadu akkada aa raatri gadipi thaanu sampaadhinchina daanilo thana annayaina eshaavu koraku oka kaanukanu
anagaa renduvandala mekalanu iruvadhi meka pothulanu renduvandala gorrelanu iruvadhi pottellanu
muppadhi paadi ontelanu vaati pillalanu nalubadhi aavulanu padhi aabothulanu iruvadhi aadugaadidalanu padhi gaadida pillalanu theesikoni mandamandanu veru verugaa
thana daasulachethi kappaginchi meeru manda mandaku naduma edamunchi naakante mundhugaa saagipondani thana daasulathoo cheppenu.
mariyu vaarilo modativaanithoo naa sahodarudaina eshaavu ninnu edurkoni-neevevarivaadavu? Ekkadiki velluchunnaavu? nee mundharanunnavi yevarivani ninnu adiginayedala
neevu ivi nee sevakudaina yaakobuvi, idi naa prabhuvaina eshaavukoraku pampabadina kaanuka; adhigo athadu maa venuka vachuchunnaadani cheppumani aagnaapinchenu.
atlathadu nenu mundhugaa pampuchunna kaanukavalana athani samaadhaanaparachina tharuvaatha nenu athani mukhamu chuchedanu; appudathadu okavela nannu kataakshinchunanukoni meeru eshaavunu chuchi
meeru-idigo nee sevakudaina yaakobu maa venuka vachuchunnaadani cheppa valenaniyu rendavavaanikini moodavavaanikini mandala vembadi vellina vaarikandarikini aagnaapinchenu.
athadu kaanukanu thanaku mundhugaa pampinchi thaanu gumpulo aa raatri nilichenu.
aa raatri athadu lechi thana yiddaru bhaaryalanu thana yiddaru daaseelanu thana padakondumandi pillalanu theesikoni yabboku revu daatipoyenu.
yaakobu vaarini theesi koni aa yeru daatinchi thanaku kaliginadanthayu pampi vesenu.
yaakobu okkadu migili poyenu; oka narudu tellavaaru varaku athanithoo penugulaadenu.
thaanu athani geluvakunduta chuchi thodagootimeeda athanini kottenu. Appudathadu aayanathoo penugulaadutavalana yaakobu thoda gooduvasilenu.
aayana-tellavaaru chunnadhi ganuka nannu ponimmanagaa athadu-neevu nannu aasheerva dinchithene gaani ninnu poniyyananenu.
aayana nee peremani yadugagaa athadu- yaakobu ani cheppenu.
appudu aayananeevu dhevunithoonu manushyulathoonu poraadi gelichithivi ganuka ikameedata nee peru ishraayele gaani yaakobu anabadadani cheppenu.
appudu yaakobu-nee peru dayachesi telupumanenu. Andu kaayana-neevu endunimitthamu naa peru adigithivani cheppi akkada athani naasheervadhinchenu.
yaakobu-nenu mukhaa mukhigaa dhevuni chuchithini ayinanu naa praanamu dakkinadani aa sthalamunaku penooyelu anu peru pettenu.
athadu penooyelunundi saagipoyinappudu sooryodayamaayenu; appudathadu thodakuntuchu nadichenu.
anduchetha aayana yaakobu thodagootimeedi thuntinaramu kottinanduna netivaraku ishraayeleeyulu thoda gootimeedanunna thuntinaramu thinaru.
yaakobu kannuletthi chuchinappudu eshaavunu. Athanithoo naaluguvandalamandi manushyulunu vachuchundiri.

appudathadu thana pillalanu leyaa raahelulakunu iddaru daaseelakunu panchi appaginchenu. Athadu mundhara daaseelanu, vaari pillalanu vaari venuka leyaanu aame pillalanu aa venuka raahelunu yosepunu unchi¸
thaanu vaari mundhara velluchu thana sahodaruni sameepinchu varaku edumaarlu nelanu saagilapadenu.
appudu eshaavu athanini edurkona parugetthi athanini kaugalinchukoni athani medameeda padi muddupettukonenu; vaariddaru kanneeru vidichiri.
eshaavu kannuletthi aa streelanu pillalanu chuchiveeru neekemi kaavalenani adiginanduku athadu veeru dhevudu nee sevakuniki dayachesina pillale ani cheppenu.
appudu aa daaseelunu vaari pillalunu daggarakuvachi saagilapadiri.
leyaayu aame pillalunu daggarakuvachi saagilapadiri. aa tharuvaatha yosepunu raahelunu daggaraku vachi saagila padiri.
eshaavunaaku edurugaavachina aa gumpanthayu endukani adugagaa athadu-naa prabhuvu kataakshamu naa meeda vachutake ani cheppenu.
appudu eshaavu-sahodarudaa, naaku kaavalasinantha unnadhi, needi neeve unchukommani cheppenu.

appudu yaakobu atlu kaadu; nee kataakshamu naameeda nunnayedala chitthaginchi naachetha ee kaanuka puchukonumu, dhevuni mukhamu chuchinatlu nee mukhamu chuchithini; nee kataakshamu naameeda vachinadhi gadaa;
nenu neeyoddhaku techina kaanukanu chitthaginchi puchukonumu; dhevudu nannu kanikarinchenu; mariyu naaku kaavalasinantha unnadani cheppi athani balavanthamu chesenu ganuka athadu daani puchukoni
-manamu velludamu; nenu neeku mundhugaa saagipovudunani cheppagaa
athadunaayoddha nunna pillalu pasipilla laniyu, gorrelu mekalu pashuvulu paalichunavi aniyu naa prabhuvuku teliyunu. Okkadhiname vaatini vadigaa thoolinayedala ee manda anthayu chachunu.

naa prabhuvu dayachesi thana daasuniki mundhugaa vellavalenu. Nenu naa prabhuvunoddhaku sheyeerunaku vachuvaraku, naa mundhara nunna mandalu naduvagaligina koladhini ee pillalu naduvagaliginakoladhini vaatini mellagaa nadipinchukoni vacchedhanani athanithoo cheppenu.
appudu eshaavu - nee kishtamaina yedala naayoddhanunna yee janulalo kondarini nee yoddha vidichipettudunani cheppagaa athadu adhiyela? Naa prabhuvu kataakshamu naameeda nundanimmanenu.
aa dinamuna eshaavu thana trovanu sheyeerunaku thirigipoyenu.
appudu yaakobu sukkothuku prayaanamai poyi thanakokayillu kattinchukoni thana pashuvulaku paakalu veyinchenu. Anduchetha aa chootiki sukkothu anu peru pettabadenu.
atlu yaakobu paddhanaraamulo nundi vachina tharuvaatha kanaanu dheshamulonunna shekemanu ooriki surakshithamugaa vachi aa oorimundhara thana gudaaramulu vesenu.
mariyu athadu thana gudaaramulu vesina polamuyokka bhaagamunu shekemu thandriyaina hamoru kumaarulayoddha nooru varahaalaku koni
akkada oka balipeethamu kattinchi daaniki el‌ eloheyi ishraayelu anu peru pettenu.
leyaa yaakobunaku kanina kumaartheyaina deenaa.aa dheshapu kumaarthelanu chooda vellenu.
aa dheshamu nelina hivveeyudaina hamoru kumaarudagu shekemu aamenu chuchi aamenu pattukoni aamethoo shayaninchi aamenu avamaana parachenu.
athani manassu yaakobu kumaartheyaina deenaa meedane undenu; athadu aa chinnadaani preminchi aamethoo preethigaa maatalaadi
ee chinnadaani naaku pendlicheyumani thana thandriyaina hamorunu adigenu.
thana kumaarthenu athadu cheripenani yaakobu vini, thana kumaarulu pashuvu lathoo polamulalo nundinanduna vaaru vachuvaraku oorakundenu.
shekemu thandriyagu hamoru yaakobuthoo maatalaadutaku athaniyoddhaku vacchenu.

yaakobu kumaarulu aa sangathi vini polamulonundi vachiri. Athadu yaakobu kumaarthethoo shayaninchi ishraayelu janamulo avamaanakaramaina kaaryamu chesenu; adhi cheyaraani pani ganuka aa manushyulu santhaapamu pondiri, vaariki migula kopamuvacchenu.
appudu hamoru vaarithoo shekemu anu naa kumaaruni manassu mee kumaarthe meedane unnadhi; dayachesi aamenu athani kichi pendlicheyudi.
mee pillalanu maakichi maa pillalanu meeru puchukoni maathoo viyyamandi maa madhya nivasinchudi.
ee dheshamu mee yeduta unnadhi; indulo meeru nivasinchi vyaapaaramuchesi aasthi sampaadhinchukonudani cheppenu.
mariyu shekemumee kataakshamu naa meeda raaneeyudi; meeremi aduguduro adhi yicchedanu.
oliyu katnamunu enthai nanu adugudi; meeru adiginantha yicchedanu; meeru aa chinnadaani naaku iyyudani aame thandrithoonu aame sahodarulathoonu cheppenu.
ayithe thama sahodariyaina deenaanu athadu cheripinanduna yaakobu kumaarulu shekemuthoonu athani thandriyaina hamoruthoonu kapatamugaa uttharamichi aninadhemanagaa
memu ee kaaryamu cheyalemu, sunnathi cheyinchu konanivaaniki maa sahodarini iyyalemu, adhi maaku avamaana magunu.
meelo prathi purushudu sunnathi pondi maavale nundinayedala sari;
aa pakshamandu mee maata koppukoni, maa pillalanu mee kichi mee pillalanu memu puchukoni, mee madhya nivasinchedamu, appudu manamu ekajanamagudumu.
meeru maa maata vini sunnathi pondani yedala maa pillanu theesikoni povudumani cheppagaa
vaari maatalu hamorukunu hamoru kumaarudaina shekemukunu ishtamugaa nundenu.
aa chinnavaadu yaakobu kumaarthe yandu preethigalavaadu ganuka athadu aa kaaryamu cheyutaku thadavucheyaledu. Athadu thana thandri yinti vaarandarilo ghanudu
hamorunu athani kumaarudaina shekemunu thama oorigavini yoddhaku vachi thama oori janulathoo maatalaaduchu

ee manushyulu manathoo samaadhaanamugaa nunnaaru ganuka vaarini ee dheshamandu unda nichi yindulo vyaapaaramu cheyaniyyudi; ee bhoomi vaarikini chaalinantha vishaalamaiyunnadhigadaa, manamu vaari pillalanu pendli chesikoni mana pillalanu vaariki itthamu.
ayithe okati, aa manushyulu sunnathi pondunatlu manalo prathi purushudu sunnathi pondinayedalane mana maataku vaaru oppukoni manalo nivasinchi yeka janamugaa nunduru.
vaari mandalu vaari'aasthi vaari pashuvu lanniyu manavagunugadaa; etlayinanu manamu vaari maataku oppukondamu, appudu vaaru manalo niva sinchedharanagaa
hamorunu athani kumaarudagu shekemunu cheppina maata athani oorigavinidvaaraa velluvaarandaru viniri. Appudathani oori gavinidvaaraa vellu vaarilo prathi purushudu sunnathi pondhenu.

moodava dinamuna vaaru baadhapaduchundagaa yaakobu kumaarulalo niddaru, anagaa deenaa sahodarulaina shimyonunu leviyu, thama katthulu chethapattukoni yevariki teliyakunda aa oorimeeda padi prathi puru shuni champiri.
vaaru hamorunu athani kumaarudaina shekemunu katthivaatha champi shekemu intanundi deenaanu theesikoni vellipoyiri
thama sahodarini cheripinanduna yaakobu kumaarulu champabadinavaaru unnachootiki vachi aa ooru dochukoni
vaari gorrelanu pashuvulanu gaadidalanu ooriloni dhemi polamuloni dhemi
vaari dhanamu yaavatthunu theesikoni, vaari pillalanandarini vaari streelanu cherapatti, yindlalonunna danthayu dochukoniri.

appudu yaakobu shimyonunu leveeni chuchi meeru nannu baadhapetti yee dhesha nivaasulaina kanaaneeyulalonu perijjeeyulalonu asahyunigaa chesithiri; naa janasankhya koncheme; vaaru naameediki gumpugaa vachi nannu champedaru;nenunu naayintivaarunu naashanamagudumani cheppenu
anduku vaaru-veshyayedala jariginchinatlu maa sahodariyedala pravarthimpavachunaa aniri.
dhevudu yaakobuthoo-neevu lechi bethelunaku velli akkada nivasinchi, nee sahodarudaina eshaavu eduta nundi neevu paaripoyinappudu neeku kanabadina dhevuniki akkada balipeetamunu kattumani cheppagaa
yaakobu thana yintivaarithoonu thanayoddha nunna vaarandari thoonu mee yoddhanunna anyadhevathalanu paaravesi mimmunu meeru shuchiparachukoni mee vastramulanu maarchukonudi.
manamu lechi bethelunaku velludamu; naashrama dinamuna naakutthara michi nenu vellina maargamuna naaku thoodaiyundina dhevuniki balipeetamunu akkada kattedhanani cheppenu.
vaaru thamayoddhanunna anyadhevathalannitini thama chevu lanunna pogulanu yaakobunaku appagimpagaa yaakobu shekemu daggaranunna masthaki vrukshamu krinda vaatini daachipettenu.
vaaru prayaanamai poyinappudu, dhevunibhayamu vaari chuttunna pattanamulameeda nundenu ganuka vaaru yaakobu kumaarulanu tharumaledu.
yaakobunu athanithoo nunna janulandarunu kanaanulo loojuku, anagaa bethelunaku vachiri.
athadu thana sahodaruni yeduta nundi paaripoyinappudu dhevudakkada athaniki pratyaksha maayenu ganuka akkada balipeetamunu katti aa chootiki el‌ bethelanu perupettiri.
ribkaa daadhiyaina deboraa chanipoyi bethelunaku diguvanunna sindhooravrukshamu krinda paathipettabadenu, daaniki allonu baakoot‌ anu peru pettabadenu.
yaakobu paddhanaraamunundi vachuchundagaa dhevudu thirigi athaniki pratyakshamai athani naasheervadhinchenu.
appudu dhevudu athanithoo nee peru yaakobu; ikameedata nee peru yaakobu anabadadu; nee peru ishraayelu ani cheppi athaniki ishraayelu anu perupettenu.
mariyu dhevudunenu sarvashakthigala dhevudanu; neevu phalinchi abhivruddhi pondumu. Janamunu janamula samoohamunu neevalana kalugunu; raajulunu nee garbhavaasamuna puttedaru.
nenu abraahaamunakunu issaakunakunu ichina dheshamu neekicchedanu; nee tharuvaatha nee santhaanamunaku ee dheshamu nicchedhanani athanithoo cheppenu.
dhevudu athanithoo maatalaadina sthalamunundi paramunaku vellenu.
aayanathanathoo maatalaadinachoota yaakobu oka sthambhamu, anagaa raathisthambhamu kattinchi daanimeeda paanaarpanamu chesi nooneyu daanimeeda posenu.
thanathoo dhevudu maatalaadinachootiki yaakobu bethelanu peru pettenu. Vaaru bethelunundi prayaanamai poyiri.
ephraathaaku vellu maargamulo marikontha dooramu unnappudu raahelu prasavinchuchu prasavavedhanathoo prayaasapadenu.
aame prasavamuvalana prayaasapaduchunnappudu mantrasaani aamethoo-bhayapadakumu; idiyu neeku kumaarudagunani cheppenu.
aame mruthibondhenu; praanamu povuchundagaa aame athani peru benoni anenu; athani thandri athaniki benyaameenu anu peru pettenu.
atlu raahelu mruthibondi betlehemanu ephraathaa maargamuna paathi pettabadenu.
yaakobu aame samaadhimeeda oka sthambhamu kattinchenu. adhi neti varaku raahelu samaadhi sthambhamu.
ishraayelu prayaanamai poyi migdal‌ ederu kavathala thana gudaaramu vesenu.
ishraayelu aa dheshamulo nivasinchuchunnappudu roobenu velli thana thandri upa patniyaina bil'haathoo shayaninchenu; aa sangathi ishraayelunaku vinabadenu.
yaakobu kumaarulu pandrenduguru, yaakobu jyeshthakumaarudagu roobenu, shimyonu, levi, yoodhaa, ishshaakhaaru, jebooloonu; veeru leyaa kumaarulu.
raahelu kumaarulu yosepu, benyaameenu.
raahelu daasiyaina bil'haa kumaarulu daanu, naphthaali.
leyaa daasiyaina jilpaa kumaarulu gaadu, aasheru veeru paddhanaraamulo yaakobunaku puttina kumaarulu.
abraahaamunu issaakunu paradheshulaiyundina mamrelo kirya tharbaaku thana thandriyaina issaakunoddhaku yaakobu vacchenu. Adhe hebronu.
issaaku bradhikina dinamulu noota enubadhi samvatsaramulu.
issaaku kaalamu nindina vruddhudai praanamu vidichi mruthibondi thana pitharula yoddhaku cherchabadenu. Athani kumaarulaina eshaavu yaakobulu athani paathipettiri.
edomanu eshaavu vamshaavali idhe,
eshaavu kanaanu kumaarthelalo hittheeyudaina elonu kumaartheyagu aadaanu, hivveeyudaina sibyonu kumaartheyaina anaa kumaartheyagu aholeebaamaanu,
ishmaayelu kumaartheyu nebaayothu sahodariyu naina baashemathunu pendliyaadenu.
aadaa eshaavunaku eleephajunu kanenu. Baashemathu ragooyelunu kanenu.
aholeebaamaa yooshunu yaalaamunu korahunu kanenu. Kanaanu dheshamulo eshaavunaku puttina kumaarulu veere.

eshaavu thana bhaaryalanu thana kumaarulanu thana kumaarthe lanu thana yintivaarinandarini thana mandalanu thana samastha pashuvulanu thaanu kanaanu dheshamulo sampaadhinchina aasthi yaavatthunu theesikoni thana thammudaina yaakobu edutanundi mariyoka dheshamunaku vellipoyenu;
vaaru visthaaramayina sampadagalavaaru ganuka vaaru kalisi nivasimpaleka poyiri. Vaari pashuvulu visheshamaiyunnanduna vaaru paradheshulai yundina bhoomi vaarini bharimpaleka poyenu.
appudu eshaavu sheyeeru manyamulo nivasinchenu. eshaavu anagaa edomu.
sheyeeru manyamulo nivasinchina edomeeyula thandriyaina eshaavu vamshaavali idhe,
eshaavu kumaarula perulu ive. eshaavu bhaaryayaina aadaa kumaarudagu eleephajunu eshaavu bhaaryayaina baashemathu kumaarudagu ragooyelunu.
eleephaju kumaarulu themaanu omaaru sepo gaathaamu kanaju. thimnaa eshaavu kumaarudaina eleephajunaku upapatni.
aame eleephajuku amaalekunu kanenu. Veeru eshaavu bhaaryayaina aadaa kumaarulu.
ragooyelu kumaarulu nahathu jerahu shammaa mijja; veeru eshaavu bhaaryayaina baashemathu kumaarulu.
eshaavu bhaaryayu sibyonu kumaartheyagu anaa kumaartheyunaina aholeebaamaa kumaarulu evaranagaa aame eshaavunaku kanina yooshu yaalaamu korahu.
eshaavu kumaarulalo veeru naayakulu; eshaavu prathama kumaarudaina eleephaju kumaarulu, themaanu naayakudu, omaaru naayakudu, sepo naayakudu, kanaju naayakudu,
korahu naayakudu, gaathaamu naayakudu, amaaleku naayakudu. Veeru edomu dheshamandu eleephaju naaya kulu. Veeru aadaa kumaarulu.

veeru eshaavu kumaarudaina ragooyelu kumaarulu, nahathu naayakudu jerahu naayakudu shammaa naayakudu mijja naayakudu; veeru edomu dheshamandu ragooyelu santhaanapu naayakulu. Veeru eshaavu bhaaryayaina baashemathu kumaarulu.
veeru eshaavu bhaaryayaina aholeebaamaa kumaarulu, yooshu naayakudu yaglaamu naayakudu korahu naayakudu; veeru anaa kumaartheyu eshaavu bhaaryayunaina aholee baamaa putrasanthaanapu naayakulu.
edomanu eshaavu kumaarulu veeru. Vaari vaari santhaanapu naayakulu veeru.
aa dhesha nivaasulaina horeeyudaina sheyeeru kumaarulu, lothaanu shobaalu sibyonu anaa
dishonu eseru deeshaanu. Veeru edomu dheshamandu sheyeeru putrulaina horeeyula naayakulu.
lothaanu kumaarulu horee hemeemu; lothaanu sahodari thimnaa
shobaalu kumaarulu alvaanu maanahadu ebaalu shapo onaamu.
sibyonu kumaarulu ayyaa anaa; aa anaa thana thandriyaina sibyonu gaadidalanu mepuchundi aranyamulo ushnadhaaralu kanugonina vaadu.
anaa santhaanamu dishonu anaa kumaartheyaina aholeebaamaa.
dishonu kumaarulu hevdoonu eshbaanu itraanu keraanu
eseru kumaarulu bil'haanu javaanu akaanu.
deeshaanu kumaarulu ooju araanu.
horeeyula naayakulu, lothaanu naayakudu shobaalu naayakudu sibyonu naayakudu anaa naayakudu
dishonu naayakudu eseru naayakudu deeshaanu naayakudu. sheyeeru dheshamandali vaari naayakula choppuna veeru horeeyula naayakulu.
mariyu e raajainanu ishraayeleeyula meeda raajya paripaalana cheyakamunupu, edomu dheshamulo raajyaparipaalana chesinaraaju levaranagaa
beyaaru kumaarudaina bela edomulo raajyaparipaalana chesenu. Athani oori peru dinhaabaa
bela chanipoyina tharuvaatha bosraa vaadaina jerahu kumaarudagu yobaabu athaniki prathigaa raajaayenu.
yobaabu chanipoyina tharuvaatha themaneeyula dheshasthudaina hushaamu athaniki prathigaa raajaayenu.
hushaamu chanipoyina tharuvaatha moyaabu dheshamandu midyaanunu kottivesina badadu kumaarudaina hadadu athaniki prathigaa raajaayenu. Athani oori peru aveethu.
hadadu chanipoyina tharuvaatha mashrekaavaadaina shamlaa athaniki prathigaa raajaayenu.
shamlaa chanipoyina tharuvaatha nadeetheera mandali rahebothuvaadaina shaavoolu athaniki prathigaa raajaayenu.
shaavoolu chanipoyina tharuvaatha akboru kumaarudaina bayal‌ haanaanu athaniki prathigaa raajaayenu.

akboru kumaarudaina bayal‌ haanaanu chanipoyinatharuvaatha hadaru athaniki prathigaa raajaayenu. Athani oori peru paayu. Athani bhaarya peru mahethabelu. aame mejaahaabu kumaartheyaina matredu kumaarthe.
mariyu vaarivaari vanshamula prakaaramu vaarivaari sthalamulalo vaarivaari perula choppuna eshaavu santhaanapu naayakula peru levanagaa thimnaa naayakudu alvaa naayakudu yathethu naayakudu
aholeebaamaa naayakudu elaa naayakudu peenonu naayakudu
kanaju naayakudu themaanu naayakudu mibsaaru naayakudu
magdeeyelu naayakudu eeraamu naayakudu. Veeru thama thama svaasthy amaina dheshamandu thamathama nivaasa sthalamula prakaaramu edomu naayakulu. eshaavu edomeeyulaku moola purushudu.
yaakobu thana thandri paradheshavaasiga undina kanaanu dheshamulo nivasinchenu.

yaakobu vamshaavali yidi. Yosepu padunedendlavaadai thana sahodarulathoo kooda mandanu mepuchundenu. Athadu chinnavaadai thana thandri bhaaryalaina bil'haa kumaarula yoddhanu jilpaa kumaarula yoddhanu undenu. Appudu yosepu vaari cheduthanamunu goorchina samaachaaramu vaari thandriyoddhaku techuchundu vaadu.
mariyu yosepu ishraayelu vruddhaapyamandu puttina kumaarudu ganuka thana kumaarulandarikante ekku vagaa athani preminchi athanikoraku vichitramaina niluvu tangee kuttinchenu.
athani sahodarulu thama thandri athanini thama andarikante ekkuvagaa preminchuta chuchinappudu vaaru athani meeda pagapatti, athanini kshema samaachaaramainanu adugaleka poyiri.
yosepu oka kala kani thana sahodarulathoo adhi teliyacheppagaa vaaru athanimeeda mari pagapattiri.
athadu vaarinichuchi-nenu kanina yee kalanu meeru dayachesi vinudi.
adhemanagaa manamu chenilo panalu kattuchuntimi; naa pana lechiniluchundagaa mee panalu naa pananu chuttukoni naa panaku saashtaangapadenani cheppenu.

andukathani sahodarulu neevu nishchayamugaa mammu neledavaa? Maameeda neevu adhi kaari vaguduvaa ani athanithoo cheppi, athani kalalanubattiyu athani maatalanubattiyu athanimeeda marintha paga pattiri.
athadinkoka kala kani thana sahodarulaku teliyachesi idigo nenu mariyoka kalakantini; andulo soorya chandrulunu padakondu nakshatramulunu naaku saashtaanga padenani cheppenu.

athadu thana thandrithoonu thana sahodarula thoonu adhi teliyacheppinappudu athani thandri atha nithoo neevu kanina yee kala yemiti? Nenu nee thalliyu nee sahodarulunu nishchayamugaa vachi neeku saashtaanga padudumaa ani athani gaddinchenu.
atani sahodarulu ataniyandu asooyapadiri. Ayite atani tandri aa maata gnaapakamunchukonenu.
athani sahodarulu shekemulo thama thandri mandanu meputaku velliri.
appudu ishraayelu yosepunu chuchi-nee sahodarulu shekemulo manda mepuchunnaaru. Ninnu vaariyoddhaku pampedanu rammannappudu athadu-manchidani athanithoo cheppenu.
appudathadu neevu velli nee sahodarula kshemamunu manda kshemamunu telisikoni naaku varthamaanamu temmani athinithoo cheppi hebronu loyalonundi athani pampenu. Athadu shekemunaku vacchenu.
athadu polamulo itu atu thirugu chundagaa oka manushyudu athanini chuchi-neevemi vedakuchunnaavani athani nadigenu.
andukathadu nenu naa sahodarulanu vedukuchunnaanu, vaaru ekkada mandanu mepuchunnaaro adhi dayachesi naaku telupumani adigenu.
anduku aa manushyudu-ikkadanundi vaaru saagi velliri. Vaarudothaanuku velludamu randani cheppukonuta vintinani cheppenu. Appudu yosepu thana sahodarula kosamu velli dothaanulo vaarini kanugonenu.
athadu daggaraku raakamunupu vaaru dooramu nundi athani chuchi athani champutaku duraalochana chesiri.
vaaru-idigo ee kalalu kanuvaadu vachuchunnaadu;
veeni champi yikkadanunna oka guntalo paaravesi, dushtamrugamu veeni thinivesenani cheppudamu, appudu veeni kalalemaguno choothamu randani okanithoo okadu maatalaadukoniri.
roobenu aa maata vinimanamu vaanini champaraadani cheppi vaari chethulalo padakunda athani vidipinchenu.

etlanagaa roobenu athani thandriki athani nappaginchutakai vaari chethulalo padakunda athani vidipimpa dalachirakthamu chindimpakudi; athaniki haani emiyu cheyaka adavilonunna yee guntalo athani padadroyudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
yosepu thana sahodarula yoddhaku vachinappudu vaaru yosepu angeeni athadu todugukoni yundina aa vichitramaina niluvutangeeni theesivesi,
athani pattukoni aa guntalo padadrosiri. aa gunta vattidi andulo neellulevu.

vaaru bhojanamucheya koorchundi, kannuletthi choodagaa aigupthunaku theesikoni povutaku guggilamu masthakiyu bola munu moyuchunna ontelathoo ishmaayeleeyulaina maargasthulu gilaadunundi vachuchundiri.
appudu yoodhaa manamu mana sahodaruni champi vaani maranamunu daachi pettinanduvalana emi prayojanamu?

ee ishmaayeleeyulaku vaanini ammi veyudamu randi; vaadu mana sahodarudu mana raktha sambandhigadaa? Vaaniki haani yemiyu cheyaraadani thana sahodarulathoo cheppenu. Andukathani sahodarulu sammathinchiri.

midyaaneeyulaina varthakulu aa meedugaa velluchundagaa, vaaru aa guntalonundi yosepunu paiki theesi aa ishmaayeleeyulaku iruvadhi thulamula vendiki athanini ammivesiri. Vaaru yosepunu aigupthunaku theesikonipoyiri.
roobenu aa guntaku thirigivachinappudu yosepu guntalo lekapogaa athadu thana battalu chimpukoni
thana sahodarula yoddhaku thirigivelli - chinnavaadu lede; ayyo nenekkadiki podunanagaa
vaaru yosepu angeeni theesikoni, oka mekapillanu champi, daani rakthamulo aa angeemunchi
aa vichitramaina niluvu tangeeni pampagaa vaaru thandriyoddhaku daanini techi-idi maaku dorikenu, idi nee kumaaruni angee avuno kaado guruthupattumani cheppiri
athadu daanini guruthupatti ee angee naa kumaarunidhe; dushta mrugamu vaanini thinivesenu; yosepu nishchayamugaa chilchabadenanenu.
yaakobu thana battalu chimpukoni thana nadumuna gonepatta kattukoni aneka dinamulu thana kumaaruni nimitthamu angalaarchu chundagaa

athani kumaaru landarunu athani kumaarthe landarunu athanini odaarchutaku yatnamu chesiri; ayithe athadu odaarpu pondanollakanenu angalaarchuchu mruthula lokamunaku naa kumaaruni yoddhaku velledhanani cheppi athani thandri athani kosamu edchenu.
midyaaneeyulu aigupthunaku athani theesikonipoyi, pharoyokka udyogasthudunu raaja sanrakshaka senaadhipathiyunaina potheepharunaku athanini ammi vesiri.
aa kaalamandu yoodhaa thana sahodarulanu vidichi heeraa anu oka adullaameeyuniyoddha undutaku vellenu.
akkada shooya anu oka kanaaneeyuni kumaarthenu yoodhaa chuchi aamenu theesikoni aamethoo poyenu.
aame garbhavathiyai kumaaruni kanagaa athadu vaaniki eru anu peru pettenu.
aame marala garbhavathiyai kumaaruni kani vaaniki onaanu anu peru pettenu.
aame marala garbhavathiyai kumaaruni kani vaaniki shelaa anu peru pettenu. aame veeni kaninappudu athadu kajeebulonundenu.
yoodhaa thana jyeshthakumaarudaina erunaku thaamaaru anu daanini pendli chesenu.
yoodhaa jyeshtha kumaarudaina eru yehovaa drushtiki cheddavaadu ganuka yehovaa athani champenu.
appudu yoodhaa onaanuthoo - nee annabhaaryayoddhaku velli maridi dharmamu jariginchi nee annaku santhaanamu kaluga jeyumani cheppenu.
onaanu aa santhaa namu thanadhi kaaneradani yerigi aamethoo poyinappudu thana annaku santhaanamu kalugajeyakundunatlu thana rethassunu nelanu vidichenu.
athadu chesinadhi yehovaa drushtiki cheddadhi ganuka aayana athanikooda champenu.

appudu yoodhaa'ithadu kooda ithani annalavale chani povu nemo anukoninaa kumaarudaina shelaa peddavaadaguvaraku nee thandriyinta vidhavaraalugaa nundumani thana kodalaina thaamaaruthoo cheppenu.Kaabatti thaamaaru velli thana thandri yinta nivasinchenu.

chaalaa dinamulaina tharuvaatha shooya kumaartheyaina yoodhaa bhaarya chani poyenu. tharuvaatha yoodhaa duḥkhanivaarana pondi, adullaameeyudaina heeraa anu thana snehithunithoo thimnaathunaku thana gorrela bochu katthirinchu vaariyoddhaku vellenu
daani maama thana gorrela bochu kattthirinchutaku thimnaathunaku velluchunnaadani thaamaarunaku telupabadenu.
appudu shelaa peddavaadai nappatikini thaanu athanikiyyabadakunduta chuchi thana vaidhavyavastramulanu theesivesi, musukuvesikoni shareeramanthayu kappukoni, thimnaathunaku povu maargamulona
yoodhaa aamenu chuchi, aame thana mukhamu kappukoninanduna veshya anukoni
aa maargamuna aame daggaraku boyi, aame thana kodalani teliyaka - neethoo poyedanu rammani cheppenu. Andukaame-neevu naathoo vachinayedala naa kemi yicchedavani adigenu.
andukathadu-nenu mandalonundi meka pillanu pampedhanani cheppinappudu aame adhi pampuvaraku emaina kuduva pettinayedala sare ani cheppenu.
athadu-nenu neeyoddha emi kuduva pettavalenani adiginappudu aame-nee mudrayu daani daaramunu nee chethikarrayunani cheppenu. Athadu vaatini aamekichi aamethoo poyenu; aame athanivalana garbhavathi
appudaame lechipoyi thana musuku theesivesi thana vaidhavyavastramulanu vesikonenu.
tharuvaatha yoodhaa aa stree yoddhanundi aa kuduvanu puchukonutaku thana snehithudagu adullaa meeyunichetha mekapillanu pampinappudu aame athaniki kanabadaledu.
kaabatti athadu-maargamandu enaayimu noddha nundina aa veshya yekkadanunnadani aa chooti manushyulanu adugagaa vaaru-ikkada veshya yevateyu ledani cheppiri.
kaabatti athadu yoodhaa yoddhaku thirigi velli'aame naaku kanabadaledu; mariyu aa chooti manushyulu'ikkadiki veshya yevateyu raaledani cheppirani aninappudu
yoodhaa-manalanu apahaasyamu chesedaremo; aame vaatini unchu konanimmu; idigo nenu ee meka pillanu pampithini, aame neeku kanabadaledu anenu.

ramaarami moodu nelalaina tharuvaatha nee kodalagu thaamaaru jaaratvamu chesenu; anthekaaka aame jaaratvamuvalana garbhavathiyainadani yoodhaaku telupabadenu. Appudu yoodhaa-aamenu bayatiki theesikonirandi, aamenu kaalchi veyavalenani cheppenu.

aamenu bayatiki theesikoni vachi nappudu aame thana maamayoddhaku aa vasthuvulanu pampi-ivi yevarivo aa manushyunivalana nenu garbhavathinaithini. ee mudra yee daaramu ee karra yevarivo dayachesi guruthu pattumani cheppinchenu.
yoodhaa vaatini guruthu pattinenu naa kumaarudaina shelaanu aameku iyyaledu ganuka aame naakante neethimanthuraalani cheppi mari yeppu dunu aamenu koodaledu.
aame prasavakaalamandu kavala vaaru aame garbhamandundiri.
aame prasavinchuchunnappudu okadu thana cheyyi bayatiki chaachenu ganuka mantrasaani erranoolu theesi vaani chethiki katti-ithadu modata bayatiki vacchenani cheppenu.
athadu thana cheyyi venukaku theesinappudu athani sahodarudu bayatiki vacchenu. Appudaameneevela bhedinchukoni vachithivanenu. Andu chetha athaniki peresu anu peru pettabadenu.
tharuvaatha thana chethini togarugala athani sahodarudu bayatikivacchenu. Athaniki jerahu anu peru pettabadenu.

yaasepunu aigupthunaku theesikoni vachinappudu pharo yokka udyogasthudunu raajasanrakshaka senaadhipathiyu naina potheepharanu noka aiguptheeyudu, akkadiki athani theesikoni vachina ishmaayeleeyulayoddha nathani konenu.
yehovaa yosepunaku thoodaiyundenu ganuka athadu vardhilluchu thana yajamaanudagu aa aiguptheeyuni yinta nundenu.
yehovaa athaniki thoodai yundenaniyu, athadu chesinadanthayu athani chethilo yehovaa saphalamu chesenaniyu athani yajamaanudu chuchinappudu

yosepumeeda athaniki kataakshamu kaligenu ganuka athani yoddha paricharya cheyuvaadaayenu. Mariyu athadu thana yintimeeda vichaaranakarthagaa athani niyaminchi thanaku kaliginadanthayu athanichethi kappaginchenu.

athadu thana yintimeedanu thanaku kaliginadanthatimeedanu athani vichaarana karthagaa niyaminchinakaalamu modalukoni yehovaa yosepu nimitthamu aa aiguptheeyuni yintini aasheervadhiṁ chenu. Yehovaa aasheervaadamu yintilo nemi athaniki kaligina samasthamumeedanu undenu.
athadu thanaku kaligina danthayu yosepu chethi kappaginchi, thaanu aahaaramu thinuta thappa thanakemi unnado emi ledo vichaarinchinavaadu kaadu. Yosepu roopavanthudunu sundarudunai yundenu.
atutharuvaatha athani yajamaanuni bhaarya yosepumeeda kannuvesi-thanathoo shayaninchumani cheppenu
ayithe athadu oppaka naa yajamaanudu thanaku kaliginadanthayu naa chethikappaginchenugadaa, naa vashamuna thana yintilo emi unnado athaderugadu; ee yintilo naakante paivaadu evadunu ledu.

neevu athani bhaaryavainanduna ninnu thappa mari dhenini naa kappagimpaka yundaledu. Kaabatti nenetlu intha ghoramaina dushkaaryamu chesi dhevuniki virodhamugaa paapamu kattukondunani thana yajamaanuni bhaaryathoo anenu.
dina dinamu aame yoseputhoo maatalaaduchundenu gaani athadu aamethoo shayaninchutakainanu aamethoo nundutakainanu aame maata vinnavaadukaadu.
atlundagaa oka naadu athadu thana panimeeda intilopaliki vellinappudu inti manushyulalo evarunu akkada leru.
appudaame aathani vastramu pattukoni thanathoo shayanimpumani cheppagaa athadu thana vastramunu aame chethilo vidichi petti thappinchukoni bayatiki paaripoyenu.
athadu thana vastramunu aame chethilo vidichi thappinchukonipovuta aame chuchinappudu
thana yinti manushyulanu pilichichoodudi, athadu manalanu egathaali cheyutaku oka hebreeyuni manayoddhaku techi yunnaadu. Naathoo shayanimpavalenani veedu naa yoddhakuraagaa nenu peddakeka vesithini.
nenu biggaragaa kekaveyuta vaadu vini naa daggara thana vastramunu vidichipetti thappinchukoni bayatiki paaripoyenani vaarithoo cheppi
athani yajamaanudu intiki vachuvaraku athani vastramu thanadaggara unchukonenu.
appudaame thana bharthathoo ee maatala choppuna cheppenu neevu manayoddhaku techina aa hebreedaasudu nannu egathaali cheyutaku naayoddhaku vacchenu.
nenu biggaragaa keka vesinappudu vaadu thana vastramu naa daggara vidichipetti thappinchukoni bayatiki paari poyenanenu
kaabatti athani yajamaanudu itlu nee daasudu nannu chesenani thana bhaarya thanathoo cheppina maatalu vinnappudu kopamuthoo mandipadi
athanini pattukoni raaju khaideelu bandhimpabadu cherasaalalo veyinchenu. Athadakkada cherasaalalo undenu.
ayithe yehovaa yosepunaku thoodaiyundi, athani yandu kanikarapadi athanimeeda aa cherasaalayokka adhipathiki kataakshamu kalugunatluchesenu.
cherasaala adhipathi aa cherasaalalonunna khaideelanandarini yosepu chethi kappaginchenu. Vaarakkada emi chesiro adanthayu athade cheyinchuvaadu.
yehovaa athaniki thoodaiyundenu ganuka aa cherasaala adhipathi athani chethiki appagimpabadina dhenigoorchiyu vichaarana cheyaka yundenu. Athadu cheyunadhi yaavatthu yehovaa saphalamagunatlu chesenu.
atupimmata aigupthuraajuyokka paanadaayakudunu bhakshyakaarudunu thama prabhuvaina aigupthuraaju edala thappuchesiri
ganuka pharo paanadaayakula adhipathiyu bhakshyakaarula adhipathiyunaina thana yiddaru udyogasthula meeda kopapadi
vaarini cherasaalalo nunchutakai raajasanrakshaka senaadhipathiki appaginchenu. adhi yosepu bandhimpabadina sthalamu.
